extracted.name: Fiesta Pinwheels
extracted.description: This fiesta pinwheels recipe makes festive appetizers with flour tortillas, cream cheese, sour cream, Cheddar cheese, taco seasoning, and picante sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 (4.5 ounce) can chopped black olives, drained
instruction_lines: Beat cream cheese, sour cream, picante sauce, taco seasoning, and garlic powder together in a small bowl until smooth; stir in Cheddar cheese, olives, and chiles.
Spread about ½ cup cream cheese mixture onto each tortilla; roll each like a jelly roll. Wrap rolls in plastic wrap. Refrigerate for 2 hours to overnight. Cut into 1-inch slices.
